adb_pair.title: Pair ADB
adb_pair.description: On your TV, go to Settings > System > Developer options and enable ADB debugging. Then click Submit. You will see a prompt on the TV to allow the connection -- approve it. If the connection fails, make sure ADB debugging is enabled and the TV is on the same network, then click Submit to try again.

error.adb_failed: Could not connect via ADB. Make sure ADB debugging is enabled on the device, the device is powered on, and you approved the connection prompt on the TV. Click Submit to try again.
